root_idea.summary: The root has two lexically distinct branches: عَيْبٌ, a fault or defect, and عَيْبَةٌ, a receptacle or repository.
root_idea.development: The defect branch covers being defective, causing a defect, and attributing a fault to someone or something. The receptacle branch extends figuratively to a trusted repository of secrets and intimate confidence; the evidence treats these branches as separate.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form I perfect citation form عَابَ rather than the inflected imperfect QAC lemma أَعِيبَ.

senses.definition: To cause something to be faulty, unsound, defective, or blemished.
senses.usage_conditions: Transitive; the Quranic occurrence is a first-person imperfect form meaning “I cause it to be defective.”

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a thing, to be or become faulty, unsound, defective, imperfect, blemished, or otherwise amiss.
To mark a person or thing as faulty; hence, to find fault with, blame, reproach, or accuse it of a vice or defect.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive use, including application to a human being as object; the fault may be attributed to the object or used as grounds for blame.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of milk, to become thick; thick or becoming thick milk.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized description of milk, including milk that has thickened in a skin or container.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or become rendered faulty, unsound, defective, imperfect, or blemished.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form V usage describing the assumption or occurrence of a defective condition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To find fault with, blame, reproach, or accuse one another.
A vice, fault, unsoundness, defect, imperfection, blemish, or other thing amiss.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Of a person or animal, it may mean a vice; of a thing, a fault or defect. The plural forms include عُيُوبٌ and أَعْيَابٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place, ground, or cause of fault; something for which blame or reproach may be assigned.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Lexical derivatives associated with عَيْبٌ; the evidence also permits variant vowel patterns.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A receptacle, case, bag, or container for clothes, goods, utensils, or harvested grain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A concrete container, commonly of skin or leather and closed with loops; its plurals include عِيَبٌ, عِيَابٌ, and عَيْبَاتٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Figuratively, a trusted repository of secrets, an intimate confidant, or the breast and heart as the place where secrets are kept.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension from a container holding valued contents; it also occurs in expressions of intimate trust and confidential peace.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An idiom meaning “attend to your own family or wife and leave me alone.”
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized, figurative expression reported in the lexical discussion; the transmitted form is preserved as supplied.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make, prepare, or take for oneself what is called an عَيْبَةٌ, a receptacle or case.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized Form II usage referring to the making or acquisition of the container.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A wooden implement used to separate and loosen cotton.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare technical meaning, distinct from عِيَابٌ as the plural of عَيْبَةٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who finds fault with, attributes faults to, or accuses others much or often.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intensive or habitual agent noun; the feminine form is عَيَّابَةٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Faulty or becoming faulty; also, making something faulty.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Active participle of the intransitive and transitive uses of عَابَ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Made or caused to be faulty, unsound, defective, or blemished.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A resultative or passive description of something brought into a defective state.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Found fault with, charged with, or accused of a vice or defect.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A resultative description of a person or thing to which a fault has been attributed.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Transitive defect meaning explicitly tied to the Quran passage.
Human-object application is covered by the broader transitive fault-attribution meaning.
Finding fault, blaming, reproaching, or accusing.
Noun meaning fault and associated ground-of-fault derivatives.
Active participle of the transitive use.
Adjectival milk-thickening use grouped with the same specialized meaning.

cautions: The public headword is normalized to the Form I perfect عَابَ; the Quran occurrence itself is the imperfect أَعِيبَها.

The Lane passage uses a historical citation rendered as xviii. 78, whereas the secure QAC occurrence supplied here is 18:79:10; the example follows the QAC location and does not convert the Lane citation.
